outcome: HBV seromarkers (HBV naive, HB vaccine responder, HBsAg carrier, recovered from HBV infection, anti-HBc-positive alone)
cohort: The study participants were 196 high-risk children born to HBeAg-positive mothers in Taiwan between 2001 and 2010.
finding: Despite receiving HBIG and HB vaccinations, high-risk Taiwanese children born to HBeAg-positive mothers had a 43.9% HBV infection rate and a 10.7% HBsAg carrier rate.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be the only significant perinatal factor that may protect newborns from becoming HBsAg carriers.
